why_en: Rumi read every isiZulu word on this page correctly: the title, the instruction and all 22 body-part labels. The only differences are in the printer's margin stamp, which a learner never sees: Rumi misread the file code "TH1" as "CSN" (and marked that line as unsure) and left out the print date and time. The PDF's text layer lists the labels in a scrambled order around the drawing, so the comparison ignores word order and counts only wrong, missing or extra words.
